source_record.english: Now sutra makes mention of the "eight expressions of a child" [one who has yet to see selflessness directly], which consist of: 1) four types where you say "I didn't see it" and so on about four different kinds of things--things that you really did see, hear, know, or sense; and 2) four types where you say "I did see it" and so on about another four kinds of things--things that you really didn't see, hear, know, or sense.
